description: This file contains macro definitions for debugging and validation, including NULL checks, condition checks, debug tracing, and a function to set the evaluation frame in Python's interpreter. It also defines an INSPECT macro for inspecting Python objects from C/C++ code, primarily used for debugging within the torch._dynamo.utils module.

methods.name: _debug_set_eval_frame
methods.description: Sets the evaluation frame function in the Python interpreter state and returns the previous function.
